verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents an open-source Airbyte Core that you can deploy locally via the open-source abctl CLI on any Docker host, or into any Kubernetes cluster. A community user confirms their company self-hosts it, so the core product is clearly self-hostable. One user reported a failed early docker-compose install, but that is an isolated anecdote rather than a documented contradiction, and another notes some security features are paid-only. Missing for 10: clear evidence that security/enterprise features such as SSO and RBAC are available in free self-hosted Core, and independent confirmation that installs are reliable.
